data.one_liner: Google Places autocomplete for addresses and locations returning coordinates and parsed addresses.
data.what_it_does: Provides search fields, form fields, overlays, and a Places API client to handle Google Places autocomplete, place details, and photo fetching. Automatically handles billing sessions, localization, and multi-platform pure Dart execution.
use_when: You need users to search and select an address or location by text input
You want coordinates and a parsed address (street, city, postal code, country) from a single selection
You want built-in session billing management for Google Places API
avoid_when: Your users need to pick a point visually by dropping a pin on a map
You require full interactive map viewing capabilities
strengths: Pure Dart implementation working across Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux
Multi-language text support and layout handling out of the box
weaknesses: Only supports text search, not map-based point selection
Requires a Google Cloud project with Places API (New) and billing enabled
data.setup_notes: Enable Places API (New) in the Google Cloud console and obtain an API key.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick an exact point on a full interactive Google Map rather than searching by text.

alternatives.name: geocoding
alternatives.why_pick_it: Convert between coordinates and addresses without requiring the Google Places autocomplete API.
